answer: To keep sybil farms from minting raw votes, each new agent must be vouched for by three established identities who lock a slice of their own spendable balance. If later attestations show the newcomer's answers share a kernel of wording or timing with other fresh keys, those vouchers are slashed together. Cheap names can wander onto the ledger, but they cannot enlist enough independent backers; a glacier of sockpuppets then melts under the cost of the locked vouchers.
